# nomatron_connectivity_agent (Data Source)

Fetch a single Nomatron connectivity agent by id or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nomatron_connectivity_agent" "example" {
  name = "test-agent"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Connectivity Agent ID. If omitted, the provider can look up the connectivity agent by exact name.
- `name` (String) Exact connectivity agent name. If omitted, the provider reads the connectivity agent by id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the connectivity agent was created.
- `created_by_id` (String) ID of the actor that created the connectivity agent, when available.
- `created_by_type` (String) Type of actor that created the connectivity agent.
- `description` (String) Description for the connectivity agent.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the connectivity agent is active.
